Items

Clerkage is charged on professional fees only. Untick "counts for clerkage" on expense lines to keep them out of the base — that matches how your bills are drawn.

Save

Just saved :
Save always asks first and files the bill under the number shown, then the next number comes up with this bill's text kept as a starting point. A saved bill is changed only through Edit in Saved invoices. Get PDF and Get Word download to your Downloads folder, as it stands or with your signature.

Letters

Type straight onto the page. Enter starts a new paragraph and Tab indents — neither saves anything. Copy a letter from Gemini and press Ctrl+V on the page: the address, subject, paragraphs and enclosures are laid out for you. Hover over Advocate or Additional Standing Counsel at the foot to keep only one.

Letters on record

The letter

Paste the letter exactly as you want it to read. It is printed as it stands under your saved letterhead — nothing is rewritten or rearranged. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.

Finish

The letter never appears on the invoice. Saving keeps it in the register below and writes a PDF into a Letters folder beside your PDFs. Save as Word writes the same letter as an editable .docx — same letterhead, same 1.5in left and 1in right margins — so you can alter the wording in Word before it goes out.

Import a rate card

Rate card

Backup folder

Two sub-folders are created inside the folder you pick — Invoices for the PDFs and Data backups for the spreadsheets. Chrome and Edge remember the folder between sessions; after restarting the browser you may be asked once to allow access again.

Invoice PDFs

Files are named by invoice number, client and date. Running it again refreshes every PDF from current data, so a corrected bill replaces its earlier copy.

Data backup

Five sheets: every invoice, every line item, clients, the rate card and a summary. Backups fill slots 001 to 050 in turn; the 51st writes over slot 001 and the cycle continues, so you always hold the last fifty.

Letterhead

Logo

Upload your own crest PNG so the letterhead matches your existing bills exactly. Until you do, the sheet uses a drawn stand-in.

Signature

Upload a photo or scan of your signature on white paper once. The paper is taken out so only the ink remains, and it sits on the page like real ink. It is used only when you choose With signature. It is kept with your own billing data in your Google Drive, not in the program.

Payment

Save a screenshot of your Google Pay / UPI QR from the app and upload it once. It then prints on every bill.

Sign-in

This keeps the register off the screen if someone else opens the file on this machine. It is not encryption — anyone who can copy the file itself can still read the data underneath, so keep the machine itself secured.

Numbering & defaults

Nudge this until it matches the blue on the bills you have already sent.

Backup

Everything lives in this browser only — nothing leaves your machine. Take a backup before you clear browsing data or move to a new laptop.
